decisions: Minutes of the October 11, 2025 board meeting approved unanimously.
Q3 2025 financial report approved; Pierre Dubois to deliver revised Q4 cash flow forecast by November 22, 2025.
Aiyana Park to schedule an executive alignment meeting with Northwind Partners by November 21, 2025.
Pierre Dubois to issue a formal payment reminder to Northwind Partners within five business days and escalate if $214,000 outstanding balance is not received within 15 business days.
Milestone-based payment terms approved in principle for Northwind Partners contract renewal; revised commercial terms to be drafted by December 6, 2025.
Recruitment of up to four senior consultants approved for Q1 2026; job postings to launch by December 1, 2025.
Project management software migration pilot approved for Q1 2026; Aiyana Park to present vendor recommendation at December board meeting.
Pierre Dubois to obtain professional liability insurance renewal quotes from at least three brokers for December board meeting.
Updated data protection policy to be finalized and distributed to all staff by December 15, 2025.
Margaret Holvan approved to represent Marbledock & Associates at the Regional Professional Services Summit on December 3, 2025.
